outcome.technical: plugins/audit/evals/build-shop.sh: the written seven-name unset line is gone. After the tool and empty-workspace checks the builder asks `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` (answered before git looks for a repository: measured with GIT_DIR naming a missing path), splits it with globbing off, refuses a word that is not a plain name, keeps the two names git itself hands on to another repository (GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT - measured with `git submodule foreach` on git 2.53, which cleared GIT_CONFIG, GIT_GRAFT_FILE, GIT_PREFIX, GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS and carried those two and GIT_NAMESPACE), refuses exit 2 when git's answer holds no GIT_DIR, and unsets the rest. Directly before `git init` a shell loop reads the environment again (`${name+set}`, set counts, empty or not: an empty GIT_DIR made git 2.53 say 'not a git repository' and 'The empty string is not a valid path', an empty GIT_INDEX_FILE made it write a `.lock`) and refuses with exit 2 ('<NAME> is set, which points git away from this workspace; ... nothing was written'). The header's repository paragraph and exit table are rewritten (exit 2 lists the new refusals under 'refused with nothing written', with the reason it is 2 and not 3); the end check built() is unchanged. GIT_NAMESPACE is no longer cleared: not on git's list, and a build with it set made the same refs and tree (measured). tests/test_build_shop.py: REDIRECT_KEPT is a pattern matching either form of the clearing line; make_box takes a pattern anchor; victim_state adds for-each-ref and reads status with --no-optional-locks; tree_bytes hashes the other repository byte for byte; redirected_build/unwritten_faults/early_refusal_faults replace kept_gitdir_build/kept_gitdir_faults/check_reached/GIT_STOPPED/REFUSING_GIT. Cases: esc47 rewritten (unconditional: not exit 0, other repository bytes+refs unchanged, workspace empty, nothing outside; every GIT_DIR spelling the host has, the label says which ran); esc57 rewritten (the early check refused: exit 2, its line naming GIT_DIR, never the end check's words); esc59 rewritten (a substitute git that turns the other repository bare at init, proved doing it first, as the windows runner's did; holds that the check precedes init); esc48 rewritten (measures on the host's git which listed names git carries into a submodule, equal to CONFIG_CARRIED); esc46 widened to every name git lists less configuration; new esc60 (other names, no GIT_DIR), esc61 (empty GIT_DIR), esc62 (nested workspace, allow), esc63 (config pairs handed to every git call, allow), esc64 (GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, GIT_NAMESPACE, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT, allow), esc65 (git answering no names is refused). esc58 kept. The 'not reached on this host' line and check_reached() are gone - no host can print it, since the refusal now reads the environment before any git write; the reviewer's low on check_reached() and the constant skip argument goes with them. Counts: 66 -> 72 cases; bare 14 s -> 19 s and 16 s; under the sweep 13.5 s -> 19.1 s and 17.6 s. Fixtures: both scenarios build the same commits, tree and files as the pre-change builder with nothing set (compared by a scratch script). Also green with dash as sh.
